attributes.action: All new vehicles sold in the UK to have fitted dashcam.
attributes.additional_details:
Last year detected fraudulent motor claims cost the industry £576 million.

This costs the average UK driver roughly £50 to £70 extra on their annual premium.

All new vehicles sold in the UK should have front and rear dashcams (cost as low as £30) in order to combat fraud and save money for the individual
attributes.background: All new vehicles sold in the UK should have a front and back dashcam to combat fraud.

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign this petition which calls for the same action:

Require all new cars sold in the UK to be fitted with dashcams
